children.name: welcome.txt
children.content:
EMPIRE OS - first boot

This machine is old, slow and yours.

Everything you do from here happens inside closed training simulations.
Nothing on this system can reach a real network.

Open the Terminal and type 'help' to see what it understands.
Check Mail for messages. Check Finance to see where your money goes.

children.content:
IDEAS

A one-person shop cannot take every job.
Pick a lane first: recovery, audits, or malware analysis.

Later: an office. People. A product with my name on it.
Later still: an empire.

children.name: terminal_guide.txt
children.content:
TERMINAL GUIDE

help            list every command
status          your profile at a glance
ls, cd, cat     look around the file system
apps            list installed applications
open <app>      launch an application, e.g. 'open mail'
clear           wipe the screen

Paths may be absolute (/docs) or relative (notes/todo.txt).
'..' goes up one folder. '~' is your home folder.

children.name: rules_of_engagement.txt
children.content:
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT

1. Work only inside the simulation a client provides.
2. Written permission first. Always.
3. Leave a system in better shape than you found it.
4. Report what you find. All of it.

Reputation is the only currency that compounds.
